sentences.en: Julius does not hear that bad Cornelius is crying.

sentences.la: Domina sē ā Cornēliō aspicī audit.
sentences.en: The mistress hears that she is being looked at by Cornelius.

sentences.la: Mēdus Albīnum bonum exīre audit.
sentences.en: Medus hears that good Albinus is going out.

sentences.la: Aemilia līberōs in hortō iacēre videt.
sentences.en: Aemilia sees that the children are lying down in the garden.

sentences.la: Māter Dēliam amīcam esse videt.
sentences.en: The mother sees that Delia is friendly.

sentences.la: Lȳdia Quīntum ab amīcō accūsārī audit.
sentences.en: Lydia hears that Quintus is being accused by the friend.

sentences.la: Servus Aemiliam venīre nōn posse videt.
sentences.en: The slave sees that Aemilia cannot come.

sentences.la: Videt Dāvus puellās in campō clāmāre.
sentences.en: Davus sees that the girls are shouting in the field.

sentences.la: Mercātor dormīre vult, sed fīliam lūdere videt.
sentences.en: The merchant wants to sleep, but sees that the daughter is playing.

sentences.la: Aemilia audit inimīcōs Albīnum interrogāre.
sentences.en: Aemilia hears that the enemies are questioning Albinus.

sentences.la: Dāvus virum malum rīdēre nōn videt.
sentences.en: Davus does not see that the bad man is laughing.

sentences.la: Māter sē ā puellīs aspicī audit.
sentences.en: The mother hears that she is being looked at by the girls.

sentences.la: Iūlia līberōs probōs cadere videt.
sentences.en: Julia sees that the good children are falling.

sentences.la: Pater mercātōrem in peristylō cantāre audit.
sentences.en: The father hears that the merchant is singing in the peristyle.

sentences.la: Puella Dēliam improbam esse videt.
sentences.en: The girl sees that Delia is bad.

sentences.la: Dēlia Lȳdiam ab Aemiliā ōrnārī audit.
sentences.en: Delia hears that Lydia is being adorned by Aemilia.

sentences.la: Iūlia Dēliam accurrere nōn posse videt.
sentences.en: Julia sees that Delia cannot run up.

sentences.la: Videt Aemilia nūntiōs in viā dormīre.
sentences.en: Aemilia sees that the messengers are sleeping in the road.

sentences.la: Mercātor dormīre vult, sed Albīnum plōrāre audit.
sentences.en: The merchant wants to sleep, but hears that Albinus is crying.

sentences.la: Mārcus audit puellās rāmōs tenēre.
sentences.en: Marcus hears that the girls are holding the branches.

sentences.la: Māter leōnem bonum iacēre nōn videt.
sentences.en: The mother does not see that the good lion is lying down.

sentences.la: Pāstor sē ā līberīs quaerī videt.
sentences.en: The shepherd sees that he is being looked for by the children.
